articles.title: Kalshi Faces Threat of Nationwide Shutdown in New York Case
articles.summary: Kalshi, one of the few legal prediction markets in the US, is fighting a potential nationwide shutdown after a case in New York. If regulators win, it could effectively kill the only accessible way Americans can legally bet on real-world events at scale.

articles.title: Norway ponders stricter bans on prediction markets
articles.summary: Norway's government is weighing tighter restrictions on prediction markets, potentially clamping down on how these platforms operate within its borders. If passed, it sets a precedent that could inspire similar regulatory crackdowns across Europe and signals that even relatively open jurisdictions aren't immune to the political pressure to restrict betting markets.

articles.title: New York judge urged Kalshi to compromise on limiting bets by anyone under 21
articles.summary: A New York judge pushed Kalshi, the CFTC-approved prediction market platform, to restrict betting access for anyone under 21 instead of fighting the age requirement outright. The move signals regulators are willing to negotiate on market access rules, which could reshape how prediction markets balance growth against compliance pressures.

articles.title: With founders facing criminal charges in Utah, Kalshi decides to ‘pause operations’ in the state
articles.summary: Kalshi, the regulated futures platform for prediction markets, is shutting down operations in Utah after two of its founders faced criminal charges in the state. This signals that even with CFTC approval, prediction market operators still face serious legal headwinds at the state level, which could constrain growth in other jurisdictions spooked by regulatory risk.

articles.title: Mets World Series Market Trending Up on Kalshi After Tarik Skubal Signing
articles.summary: The Mets grabbed Tarik Skubal in free agency, and their World Series odds on Kalshi are climbing as a result. A legitimate ace addition this late in the offseason signals serious contention intent, which typically moves money and shifts market consensus in prediction markets.

articles.title: Prediction markets put Jensen Huang’s odds of returning at 11% on Sunday night—hours later he was back as Nvidia CEO
articles.summary: Jensen Huang stepped away from Nvidia's CEO role over the weekend, and prediction markets gave him just an 11% chance of returning,before he promptly did exactly that hours later. The miss raises a familiar question: are these markets actually pricing in private information, or are they just confident guesses that occasionally blow up in public.

articles.title: Prediction Market Rule From CFTC Under White House Review
articles.summary: The CFTC just proposed new rules for prediction markets and the White House is currently reviewing whether to greenlight them. If approved, this could either unlock the market's potential or strangle it depending on how restrictive the final language turns out to be.

articles.title: New York Authors A Useful, Information Rich Prediction Market Standard
articles.summary: New York regulators just blessed a standardized framework for prediction markets that actually makes sense, which means other states will probably copy it instead of reinventing the wheel. Having shared rules across jurisdictions kills the regulatory arbitrage game and lets prediction market platforms scale without hiring a compliance team per state.

articles.title: Democrats put campus gambling in the crosshairs
articles.summary: Democrats are moving to restrict or ban gambling operations on college campuses, targeting everything from sportsbooks to daily fantasy sports apps marketed to students. This matters because regulatory crackdowns on campus betting could reshape the entire college sports betting ecosystem and potentially crater some operators' growth projections if restrictions gain real traction.

articles.title: Most winnings on Polymarket midterm bets went to top 1% of bettors, report says
articles.summary: The top 1% of Polymarket bettors captured the majority of winnings from the 2022 midterm elections, suggesting prediction markets concentrate wealth among sophisticated traders rather than distributing it evenly. This matters because it raises questions about whether Polymarket actually functions as a diverse information-aggregation engine or just another casino rigged for professionals.

articles.title: How Luana Lopes Lara built Kalshi into a $40 billion prediction market giant that overtook Polymarket
articles.summary: Luana Lopes Lara scaled Kalshi from obscurity to a $40B valuation and market dominance over the previously untouchable Polymarket, proving that founder execution and regulatory navigation beat first-mover advantage in prediction markets. If Kalshi can dethrone the category leader, it signals that the prediction market wars are still wide open and retail adoption is reaching escape velocity.

articles.title: Kalshi Claims New York’s Lawsuit Could Shut It Down Everywhere
articles.summary: Kalshi is facing a New York lawsuit that the exchange claims could force it to shut down operations nationwide, not just in the state. If New York wins, it could set a precedent that lets other states challenge prediction market platforms, potentially fragmenting the entire industry into a patchwork of regulatory battles.
